free_tier.stated: trial credits exist and the amount is not published. The vendor's own billing article states 'Once your trial credits are used up, any additional charges will be billed to the card attached to your account', and the onboarding articles require an SSH public key, a verified phone number and a valid credit card before an instance launches.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: the prepaid balance lasts up to three years, which makes Genesis a place to park a balance rather than a credit to spend quickly; the trial credit itself is short-lived and unquantified.

limits.value: the onboarding wall binds before any credit is spent: phone verification, an SSH key and a card on file are all required, and a quota request follows for GPU classes.

identity_cost.detail: card plus phone plus an SSH key: 'Make sure to upload an SSH key, besides verifying your phone number and adding a valid credit card. Once this is done, your basic setup is done'. The card must be 3D Secure and a card already attached to another Genesis Cloud account is refused by default; Genesis places a temporary USD 1 hold that 'is not a charge and will be automatically released after 7 days', and refuses prepaid cards by default. Charges after the trial are 'billed to the card attached to your account on the first of each month'. SEPA Direct Debit in EUR is accepted 'alongside cards and wire transfers'.

notes: The amount is the open question and it is left null rather than guessed. A vendor blog post from 2022 states USD 15 on signup; referral sites in 2026 advertise USD 100 through a referral link.
